verdict.rationale: Cortex Analyst is a documented first-party feature that lets users ask natural-language questions and get answers without writing SQL. Snowflake CoWork ("Ask anything") and CoCo ("Build anything") suggest broader natural-language operation, but the evidence is only homepage taglines. The documented capability covers querying data, not operating the product as a whole. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of administration and operations (warehouses, objects, users, pipelines), substantive docs for CoWork/CoCo, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
